No hidden searches or extrapolation are used. The complete included verifier has been executed successfully from the packaged path.

value.rationale: The twenty-vertex Desargues graph is a standard highly symmetric cubic graph, and minimum ordinary location-domination is a natural unique-neighborhood sensor-placement invariant. A scalar minimum does not give the exact number or geometry of optimal placements. The classification determines all 1,475 optimal placements and their 13 S5xC2 orbits, with meaningful 3+5/4+4/5+3 placement asymmetry and a nontrivial independent lower-bound obstruction. This is a complete natural finite classification, with no exaggerated implication of a general graph-family formula.
